up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649943, retrieve all activity records including standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and standard_type, along with the canonical SMILES and ChEMBL ID of the tested compound. Return one row per activity record. Columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649943' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL;
